extracted_concepts.name: L'Hôpital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rule computing limits of quotients from limits of derivative quotients.

extracted_concepts.name: 0/0 Case
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where both numerator and denominator tend to 0.

extracted_concepts.name: ∞/∞ Case
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where both numerator and denominator tend to infinity.

extracted_concepts.name: Indeterminate Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A limit form whose value is not determined by individual limits.

extracted_concepts.name: 0·∞ Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Product indeterminate form involving 0 and infinity.

extracted_concepts.name: ∞−∞ Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Difference indeterminate form involving infinities.

extracted_concepts.name: 1^∞ Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Power indeterminate form with base tending to 1 and exponent to infinity.

extracted_concepts.name: 0^0 Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Power indeterminate form with base and exponent tending to 0.

extracted_concepts.name: ∞^0 Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Power indeterminate form with base tending to infinity and exponent to 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Value approached by a function as its input approaches a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio of Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The quotient f'(x)/g'(x) used in L'Hôpital's Rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit of Ratio of Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Existence condition for lim f'(x)/g'(x) in L'Hôpital's Rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithm Transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Taking logarithms to handle power indeterminate forms.

extracted_concepts.name: Rewrite as Fraction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rewriting a product form as a quotient for L'Hôpital's Rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Combine Fractions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Combining fractions to handle ∞−∞ forms.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit Computation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of evaluating limits.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Infinite series representing a function using derivatives at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor's Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expands a function into a polynomial plus remainder using derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Maclaurin Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Taylor series centered at a = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Remainder Term
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: R_n measuring error of Taylor polynomial approximation.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximating a function by a polynomial.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: First-order approximation using the tangent line.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-order Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives beyond the first, used in Taylor expansions.

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of infinitely many terms.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of finding derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series e^x = Σ xⁿ/n!.

extracted_concepts.name: Sine Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series for sin x.

extracted_concepts.name: Cosine Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series for cos x.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Series 1/(1-x)=Σ xⁿ for |x|<1.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithmic Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Series for ln(1+x).
